name: claudeconnect
notes: Update available now reaches the site reliably. Your computer checks for new versions itself every minute, from its own connection (GitHub often turns away Cloudflare's servers, which the site runs on), and reads them at the newest commit, so GitHub's five-minute cache can't hold a new version back. Check again asks your computer too, an out-of-date copy can't hide a newer version, and an update that didn't finish no longer hides the next one.

A new look, matching ChatGPT as it is now: black in dark (white in light) with the site's name at the top of the sidebar, Recents, a Chat | Files switch at the top, the model and effort in the message box, and the blue send button.

The file browser reaches everything your site can: the working folder, your home folder with its Desktop, Documents and Downloads, other folders it's allowed into, and the whole computer. Open it from Files in the sidebar or the Chat | Files switch.

Text and code files can be edited in the file browser and saved to your computer (Ctrl+S or ⌘S works too), keeping their line endings. If the file changed on your computer meanwhile, it asks before saving over it.
Audio plays in the site's own player: play and pause, 10 seconds back and forward, a bar to drag, the volume and the speed.
The file browser's buttons say what they do when you point at them.
Questions like "Move to Trash?" or "Delete this chat?" are asked in the site's own dialog, never the browser's pop-ups.
Each model only lists the effort levels it has: Haiku 5.5 has no Ultracode. An effort a model doesn't have runs as the nearest one below it.
